text: TeamViewer SE is a Frankfurt-listed software company; its own annual report records free float at 100% of share capital at 31 December 2025, with only 4% held as treasury shares. No shareholder reaches the 3% disclosure threshold, meaning no state or family block. The Mercedes partnership is private corporate money.
